PLAN "12-Week General Strength (Post-L4-L5 Safe)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "general strength without spinal loading"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body + Core (Spine-Safe)":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull (Intro)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          seated_row 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
